_meta.description: Image manifest — every image slot the site reads from. Drop real exports into the matching folder following the filename pattern. Until then, /assets/images/_placeholders/<slot>.svg is shown via the image-fallback.js handler.

mobile.guidance: Vertical crop. Couple positioned upper-right so headline fits bottom-left.

desktop.guidance: Couple in lower third, room for headline overlay bottom-left, sky/sea behind.

hero-homepage.description: Couple in soft golden-hour light along 30A. Warm tones, room for headline overlay bottom-left. The defining brand image.
hero-homepage.alt_suggestion: Bride and groom share a quiet moment at golden hour on a 30A beach.

hero-portfolio.description: Cinematic editorial portrait that sets the tone for the portfolio hub.

hero-about.description: Shane behind the camera or candid working shot. Honest, warm, in-the-moment.

homepage-feature-weddings.description: Bridal moment, ceremony or first-look, with movement and light.

homepage-feature-engagements.description: Couple connection, golden hour outdoor session.

homepage-feature-elopements.description: Intimate two-person elopement, private and quiet.

homepage-feature-destination.description: Beach or destination wedding signature shot — turquoise water, white dress.

homepage-story-1.description: Storytelling row 1 image — paired with brand voice copy.

homepage-story-2.description: Storytelling row 2 image — beach detail or candid moment.

homepage-final-cta.description: Full-bleed closer — couple silhouette or wide environmental portrait.

weddings-gallery.description: Curated wedding portfolio. Mix of vertical and horizontal. Number sequentially.

about-portrait.description: Vertical portrait of Shane Drummond, used on About page split layout.

package-essential.description: Card thumbnail for the entry-level package.

package-signature.description: Card thumbnail for the mid-tier package.

package-heirloom.description: Card thumbnail for the premium package, including album.

lead-magnet-cover.description: Tilted PDF preview mockup of the Wedding Planning Guide.

blog-cover-default.description: Default blog cover used when a post lacks its own image.
